title: ALTERNATE
description: Adds a new alternate dimension with a cheap twist
body:
This mod adds a whole new dimension with a entity that will stalk and kill you.
If you go to bed you'll enter a "middle dimension" the transistion between the overworld and the new dimension. If you go to bed, you will enter the "middle dimension". And if you leave the game you'll directly enter the alternate dimension.(it should aslo be mentioned that this is peak slop horror)

# Dimensions
- Isolated(middle) dimesnsion
- Alternate Dimension

# Entities
-This mod adds a brand new entity called the Alternate Player

# Structures
-This mod adds 2 new structures
